caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled carriage with thin, black spokes and rims. The carriage body is an open design with a single passenger seat, which is upholstered in a dark material. The central body of the carriage is painted a dark brown color, with a side panel that is highlighted in a yellowish shade, possibly suggesting a wooden or woven texture. A large, curved canopy or hood, also brown in color, extends over the seating area, providing shelter from above. The hood tapers down toward the front of the carriage, and its interior is shaded darker than the exterior. At the front, two lamps with metallic components are mounted, and a simple, thin steering mechanism is visible. The rear section includes a small, flat luggage platform above the rear wheels, supported by thin, black metal struts. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Phaeton
